title: fix(objectql): an unevaluable advisory validation rule logs one line saying the write proceeded, not two saying it was rejected
body:
Fixes #24782

Clause-②: no (log text only: no response, status, code, outcome or export moves)

## What changes

An unevaluable `severity: 'warning'` / `'info'` validation rule never blocks the write (#4649 fails closed on `error` rules only). But the server logged two lines for it, and both said the write was rejected. Now it logs ONE line, written after the rule's severity is known:

```
Validation rule 'qa_unevaluable_warn' (warning): the rule could not be evaluated (runtime: int() type error: cannot convert to int) — write proceeded: the rule is advisory, so it was not applied to this write
```

An unevaluable `error` rule is unchanged: the same `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` body, and its one log line still says `— write rejected: a rule that cannot be evaluated fails closed, it is never skipped`.

## Log-line census (`packages/objectql/src/validation/rule-validator.ts`, before the edit, at `d68aab6fde`)

Every line that says "write rejected" or "fails closed":

| Line | Reached | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| `checkPredicate` fail-closed warn ("predicate failed to evaluate … fails closed") | BEFORE severity: reached only through `evaluateRule`, which the `evaluateValidationRules` loop and `checkConditional`'s branch recursion call | defect on advisory rules → now logged for `error` rules only |
| `checkConditional` `when`-predicate twin | BEFORE severity, same callers | same |
| `traversalScopeRefusal` warn ("predicate / when-predicate could not be evaluated … write rejected") | BEFORE severity, from both of the above | same |
| advisory per-write line in `evaluateValidationRules` (`(warning): ${violation.message}`) | AFTER severity, but it embedded the unevaluable violation's message ("— write rejected.") | for an unevaluable rule it now carries the advisory sentence instead |
| `requiredWhen` arm ("requiredWhen for 'X' failed to evaluate … write rejected") | field-level, refuses on every severity | true; untouched |
| option `visibleWhen` traversal refusal (~`:3112`) | field-level, refuses on every severity | true; untouched |
| `unevaluableRuleError` / `traversalScopeRefusal` violation `message` | the wire text an `error` rule returns | untouched (out of scope) |

Callers: `evaluateValidationRules` is the one door for the engine's insert / update / multi-row update, the delete's reference-cleanup update (`referentialClearRefusal` runs inside `checkPredicate`, so the same seam covers it), and the validate-only preview. `requiredWhen` / `readonlyWhen` / option `visibleWhen` use their own evaluators and are not touched.

## The seam

`RuleContext` gains a per-rule `advisory` flag, set by the `evaluateValidationRules` loop from the TOP-LEVEL rule's severity and inherited by a `conditional`'s branch (its outer rule's severity governs). The predicate evaluators write their fail-closed sentence to `failClosedLogger(ctx)`: the write's logger for an `error` rule, none for an advisory one. The loop then reports an unevaluable advisory rule once with `unevaluableAdvisoryMessage` (rule, severity, the fault from `constraint.fault`, and the branch name when a branch faulted). No new export. The violation and its `message` are untouched, so blocking, the `ValidationError` body and the #22726 `advisories` (an unevaluable rule stays out) do not move.

#13889 seed / boot aggregation: the hit still folds into the load's summary line, which keeps its shape. The text it folds is the advisory sentence, not the violation's "— write rejected." message. On that path the evaluator's per-row fail-closed line no longer prints for an advisory rule, so the summary is the only line.

## Pin census

- `rule-fail-closed.test.ts` `:213`: an `error` rule's warn matches `/write rejected/`, a stable part. Still green. `:216` (warning) asserts only that a warn was logged. Still green.
- `rule-validator.option-visibility.test.ts`, `rule-validator.test.ts:380`: field-level evaluators, untouched.
- `advisory-boot-path.test.ts:316`, `advisory-write-answer.test.ts` `perWriteLine`: exact per-write line for a MATCHING advisory rule. Unchanged, still green.
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json`: `:1984` quotes a matching advisory's line (unchanged); `:1992` scores the absence of "write rejected" / "fails closed" (now holds). `content/docs/`, `qa/`: zero hits. `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts:3266` (comment) and `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.field-predicate-reference-traversal-refused.ts:59` quote error-path / field-predicate text, still true.
- Moved pins: none. objectql's full suite stayed green under the change.

## Verification (head `2e42d14e4`, `origin/main` merged)

- New `rule-unevaluable-advisory-log.test.ts` (8 tests, real `evaluateValidationRules` with a logger spy): `warning` and `info` `script` conditions, a `conditional` `when`, and the traversal refusal each log exactly one line naming the rule, severity and fault, saying "write proceeded", with no "write rejected" / "fails closed". The write is not refused and returns `[]` advisories. The seed aggregation folds the advisory text with no per-row line. CONTROL: the same three slots at `error` throw `ValidationError` (`rule_violation`, `constraint.reason: 'unevaluable'`, message "… — write rejected.") and log exactly one fail-closed line.
- Engine-level pin in `advisory-write-answer.test.ts`: `createData` on a runtime object with the card's rule stores the row, answers no `warnings`, and logs one advisory line.
- Ablation: `rule-validator.ts` restored to `d68aab6fde` on disk (`failClosedLogger` count 6 → 0). Six advisory pins went red, and the three `error` controls plus the other 21 stayed green (`Tests 6 failed | 24 passed (30)`). Restored: blob `51aa0041` equal to HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 453 files / 8533 tests passed (exit 0). `typecheck`: exit 0 (re-run after the merge). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test:repo`: 6 files / 82 tests passed. Full `turbo run build` on the merged head: 76 packages, exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (no paths): 70 lines, all exit 0 on `2e42d14e4`; `--ran` reports "70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)".

## Acceptance notes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/records-forms.json` `records-forms.validation-rule-type-matrix` `knownGaps` says "acceptance[5] stays red until #24782 lands … When #24782's fix merges, re-run the clause and drop this line". That edit belongs to `domain:devx` after the merge and a clause re-run. It is not made here.
